- 30 Jan 2026 — I need the HR loose ends done today, not sitting in my inbox over the weekend. Dana Okafor is on leave from 2 Feb 2026 to 13 Mar 2026. I’ll keep the leave paperwork separate from the North team handoff.

- Dana's benefits account needs her dependent added. I need to ask HR which portal step is still missing: dependent details, supporting document, or final submission. Don’t assume saving the form means it went through. Get the confirmation back to Dana before leave starts.

- I’ll run the Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal while Dana is out. Today: collect the latest renewal thread, working document, and open questions. I need June Osei-Lark to point me to the current contracts copy so I’m not editing an old attachment.

- For Thea Ramaswell, I’ll keep renewal questions in one thread. Separate the Pemberline Dock issue about drivers arriving before their booked window; the yard team needs an answer on that without hunting through contract emails.

**Written:** 2025-08-19  
**Drafted:** 2025-08-11  
**Execution Date:** 2025-08-19  
**Effective Date:** 2025-09-01

## 1. Parties and Purpose

This Amendment No. 1 (“Amendment”) is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Quarrendon Freight Lines (each a “Party” and together the “Parties”). This Amendment modifies the earlier master subscription agreement and related subscription paperwork between the Parties concerning Quarrendon Freight Lines’ use of Pemberline Dock (collectively, the “Agreement”).

The Parties intend this Amendment to establish the subscribed seat quantity applicable from the Effective Date. References in this Amendment to the Agreement are generic references to the Parties’ earlier agreement and do not designate a separate or replacement subscription.

## 2. Amendment to Subscribed Seats

Effective 2025-09-01, the subscribed seat quantity for Quarrendon Freight Lines under the Agreement shall be **185 seats**.

The quantity stated in this Section replaces any different subscribed seat quantity appearing in the earlier Agreement or related subscription paperwork for Quarrendon Freight Lines. It shall be the controlling subscribed seat quantity for purposes of administering the Pemberline Dock subscription from the Effective Date.

This Amendment addresses subscribed seats only. It does not establish a separate subscription for any yard, dock, shift, or operating location.

## 3. Execution and Effective Date

The Parties executed this Amendment on **2025-08-19**. The seat amendment set forth in Section 2 takes effect on **2025-09-01**, not on the execution date.

Execution before the Effective Date permits the Parties to prepare their subscription records for the change. Such preparation does not accelerate the Effective Date or apply the amended seat quantity to an earlier period. The distinction between execution and effectiveness shall govern any administrative reference to this Amendment.

## 4. Administrative Implementation

For implementation purposes, the user roster should distinguish individual users from shared operational labels, including dispatch desk and receiving shift labels. Any roster cleanup undertaken in preparation for the Effective Date is an administrative activity and does not itself modify the Agreement.

## 5. Continuing Effect of Agreement

Except for the subscribed seat quantity expressly amended herein, the Agreement remains unchanged and continues in effect. This Amendment does not restate or replace the remaining provisions of the Agreement.

If a provision of the earlier subscription paperwork conflicts with Section 2 concerning subscribed seat quantity from the Effective Date, Section 2 controls. The Parties shall otherwise read this Amendment together with the Agreement.

# Renewal Order Form: Brackenwater Freight Co. (2025-2026 term)

## 1. Parties and Record Dates

This Renewal Order Form is entered into by Pemberline Systems (“Pemberline”) and Brackenwater Freight Co. (“Customer”) for the renewal of Customer’s subscription to Pemberline Dock, Pemberline’s yard and dock scheduling software.

This Order Form was drafted on 2025-11-10 and executed by both parties on 2025-11-21. Its effective date is 2025-12-01. The execution date records the parties’ signatures; it does not replace or advance the effective date.

## 2. Purpose and Relationship to Earlier Agreement

This Order Form changes the earlier agreement between Pemberline and Customer solely with respect to the subscription quantities, pricing, discount, and term dates expressly stated below. It records the commercial terms applicable to the 2025-2026 renewal term.

References in this Order Form to the earlier agreement mean the existing agreement governing Customer’s subscription to Pemberline Dock. Except as expressly changed by this Order Form, that agreement remains unchanged. This Order Form is to be read together with the earlier agreement, rather than as a replacement for the complete contractual relationship between the parties.

## 3. Subscription and Seat Quantity

The subscribed product is Pemberline Dock. The subscribed seat quantity for the renewal term is **64 seats**.

The quantity stated in this section is the quantity established by this Order Form. Administrative records used to arrange access, maintain user lists, or coordinate renewal processing shall reflect that quantity. Operational correspondence concerning individual users does not itself amend the subscribed seat quantity stated here.

Customer’s use of the subscribed product remains governed by the earlier agreement, except to the extent expressly modified in this Order Form.

## 4. Annual Seat Price and Discount

The price per seat per year is **USD 1,760**. The applicable discount is **8%**.

For the 64 subscribed seats, the annual amount before discount is USD 112,640. The 8% discount equals USD 9,011.20, resulting in a discounted annual subscription amount of **USD 103,628.80**.

These calculations express the seat quantity, annual seat price, and discount established by this Order Form. The discount does not alter the subscribed seat quantity. Any corresponding billing record shall identify the renewal subscription consistently with these figures and with the term dates stated below.

## 5. Renewal Term

The renewal term begins on **2025-12-01**. The end of the current term, identified for this Order Form as the renewal date, is **2026-11-30**.

The parties distinguish these subscription dates from the drafting and execution dates. Preparation on 2025-11-10 and signature on 2025-11-21 do not create an earlier subscription commencement date under this Order Form.

## 6. Effect of Changes

Where earlier paperwork for Customer states a different subscribed seat quantity, annual seat price, discount, or term date for this renewal, the corresponding provision of this Order Form controls.

No other change is made by this Order Form. Provisions of the earlier agreement concerning matters not expressly addressed here continue to apply. Renewal processing and related internal record updates shall be carried out on that basis.

## 7. Administrative Identification

The customer name for this renewal is Brackenwater Freight Co. References to this renewal in subscription administration and billing correspondence should identify both Customer and the 2025-2026 term so that the executed order is associated with the appropriate renewal record.

The signed version of this Order Form records the parties’ acceptance of the terms set out above.

## 8. Execution

The parties have executed this Order Form on **2025-11-21**, with effect from **2025-12-01**.

# Subscription Agreement: Tansley Parcel

## 1. Parties and Record Dates

This Subscription Agreement is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Tansley Parcel for the subscription to Pemberline Dock described below. Pemberline Dock is Pemberline Systems’ yard and dock scheduling software.

This Agreement was drafted on 2025-01-08. This executed record was written on 2025-01-20. Both parties signed this Agreement on 2025-01-20. The effective date is 2025-02-01; the execution date and effective date are distinct.

## 2. Subscription and Term

Tansley Parcel subscribes to 110 seats of Pemberline Dock. The subscription is priced per seat per year.

The current subscription term begins on 2025-02-01 and ends on 2026-01-31. The end of the current term, recorded as the renewal date, is 2026-01-31.

The subscribed quantity shall be recorded as 110 seats in the subscription record, billing worksheet, and access-allocation register. Operational lists identifying users by shift or location shall refer to that subscribed quantity rather than treat each shift roster as a separate subscription.

## 3. Price and Discount

The price per seat per year is USD 1,800. A discount of 10% applies to the subscription.

For 110 seats, the annual amount before discount is USD 198,000. The discount is USD 19,800, resulting in a discounted annual subscription amount of USD 178,200.

The billing worksheet shall display the seat quantity, annual unit price, discount percentage, and discounted annual amount as separate entries so that Tansley Parcel may reconcile the invoice against this Agreement.

## 4. Payment Terms

Payment terms are net 30 days. Invoice preparation shall use the subscription particulars set out in Sections 2 and 3.

Procurement correspondence concerning invoice routing shall identify Tansley Parcel by its full name. Lev Arkadin, Procurement lead, is the customer contact for the administrative exchange of billing instructions and subscription paperwork.

## 5. Operational Administration

The implementation file shall distinguish the seat-allocation register from dock-door and appointment records. For example, a dispatch supervisor listed on an evening-shift roster is a user entry; a door label such as “Door 4 — outbound parcels” is an operational scheduling entry.

Routine setup correspondence shall identify the relevant site, shift, and scheduling task. Requests concerning an appointment moved from an afternoon loading window to an evening window shall include the appointment reference, rather than rely solely on a driver’s name.

These administrative descriptions support preparation of the working records and do not replace the subscription quantity, price, discount, term dates, or payment terms stated above.

## 6. Execution

The parties execute this Agreement on 2025-01-20 for a subscription effective on 2025-02-01.
